en: Black‑and‑white view of a railway station area with several parallel train tracks in the foreground and people walking across the tracks. On the left stands a multi‑story corner building labeled "VICTORIA-HOTEL," with balconies and traditional Central European architecture. Other urban buildings line the tracks further back, including a brick structure with turrets, and semaphore railway signals. Rolling hills and fields form the background landscape. There are various telegraph or power poles and a small trackside hut visible.
